quest.title: Bantan Sango Case File
quest.description: You hear of a mysterious store called the Bantan Sango Detective Agency in Inazuma...

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Now, you look kinda interested in the detective agency.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: You want to be a detective? It's a tough job. Don't let fiction fool you.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: There are no thrilling chases or life and death decisions during cases.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Real detective work is more along the lines of files that fill an entire room, muddy mountain roads, and suspects who leave nary a trace...

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Maybe it's hard to understand from me just describing it... I happen to have a small case open. Why don't you get some personal experience in?

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: My assistant, Ryuuji, went out to collect clues a little while ago and still hasn't returned.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: He should have collected enough clues by now, though.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Could you go get Ryuuji for me?

choices.text: He isn't in any danger, is he?

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: I went over everything with him. Even if something unexpected happens, he should be able to handle it.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: What I'm more concerned about is whether he has found what I'm looking for or not.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: So I'll wait for your news and of course, you will get paid. Plus... it's a chance for you to experience the life of a detective.

choices.text: There couldn't have been an accident, right?...

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Not likely. I covered everything with him.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Even if something unexpected happens...

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: With his skills, he should be able to take care of himself.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: What I'm more concerned about is whether he has found what I'm looking for or not.

choices.text: It sounds like quite a hassle...

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: That's right. Detectives are professional problem solvers.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Thrilling chases and life and death decisions are just for the novels.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Real detective work is more along the lines of files that fill an entire room, muddy mountain roads, and suspects who leave nary a trace...

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: But the novels do get one thing right: detectives always have a variety of assistants.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So you also have assistants, then?

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Of course. Mine is busy outside, as a matter of fact. So now... I'm in need of another one.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Would you be willing to help me?

dialogues.speaker: Amano
dialogues.text: Miss Sango, is this true?

dialogues.speaker: Andou
dialogues.text: Are the serial burglaries in the city really the work of Treasure Hoarders?

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: That's for certain. I've just shown you the evidence, I'm sure that with your professional instincts, you should have already figured that out.

dialogues.speaker: Andou
dialogues.text: The Treasure Hoarders... how dare they! They have no regard for us at all, do they?

dialogues.speaker: Andou
dialogues.text: Amano! Let's go back and report this.

dialogues.speaker: Andou
dialogues.text: We must step up our patrols. We can't give these jerks a single opening.

dialogues.speaker: Amano
dialogues.text: Miss Sango, may we borrow the evidence? We need it to convince the higher-ups to take action.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: No problem, go ahead. It's not within our agency's ability to handle the Treasure Hoarders. We'll have to rely on the police for that.

dialogues.speaker: Andou
dialogues.text: Please rest assured! We shan't let any of the Treasure Hoarders off!

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Thank you. Now... everything should be ready.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Yes. The two Doushin from the police station are important "assistants" in closing this case.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: After the two Doushin step up their patrols, the Treasure Hoarders in town will be on high alert.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Ryuuji, you fought with the Treasure Hoarders at the place I asked you to go to, right?

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Yes. Traveler and I fought them off.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Hmm... that's good. You've probably made quite a splash.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: All we have to do now is wait for our opportunity.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Thank you for your help, Traveler. Here's your remuneration.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm not sure I've done anything to help...

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Don't say that. You attracted Andou's attention by being an outlander, and got him and Amano to chase you and rendezvous with Ryuuji...

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Now they've seen the threat of the Treasure Hoarders with their own eyes, which will cause them to step up patrols in the city...

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: That was all something only you could have done.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: After all, it was more effective to let the Doushin witness the Treasure Hoarders themselves than for me to just tell them.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Anyway, take these. Who knows? Maybe I'll need your help again some time.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: I am a detective, so I plan on solving the case, of course.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: The two Doushin from the police station are important "assistants" in closing that case.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Ah. You're the assistant Sango was talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You were expecting me?

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Well... not really. It's just Sango said that someone was coming to help out.

dialogues.speaker: Andou
dialogues.text: Hey, what are you guys doing?

dialogues.speaker: Amano
dialogues.text: Are those Treasure Hoarders? Why are they so close to the city...

dialogues.speaker: Andou
dialogues.text: Ryuuji, why are you here? And this suspicious outlander...

response.speaker: Andou
response.text: Yeah, I mean, you're the only outlander here.

response.speaker: Amano
response.text: Alright, let's not be overly sensitive. Ryuuji, what brings you here?

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: I was following a suspicious person here according to Sango's instructions, but then I bumped into some Treasure Hoarders.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: The Traveler is an assistant invited by Sango. We just drove the Treasure Hoarders off together.

response.speaker: Amano
response.text: I see... But why would there be Treasure Hoarders nearby?

response.speaker: Andou
response.text: Ryuuji, you just mentioned you were following some suspicious people... Hey! Did you follow the Treasure Hoarders from inside the city?

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: I think so. Sango's been dealing with a serial theft case. I've been searching the city based on her hunch.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Shortly after, I spotted a suspicious man near Hanamizaka. He left in a panic after I just asked a couple of questions.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: I followed him out of town, and you all know what happened after that.

response.speaker: Andou
response.text: Hmm... Ryuuji, how are you suddenly so good at talking? You weren't much of a talker before.

response.speaker: Amano
response.text: Working with Sango makes you a good speaker, I see, eh?

choices.text: What are you two doing here?

response.speaker: Amano
response.text: Andou said that there was a suspicious blonde outlander wandering around town, so we came to have a look.

response.speaker: Amano
response.text: That's why we followed you. I didn't know that you were Sango's assistant. Sorry for the misunderstanding.

response.speaker: Amano
response.text: Ah... Ryuuji, you said that you found the suspicious person in the city, right?

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: That's correct.

response.speaker: Andou
response.text: How dare they try to sink their paws into our city...

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Yeah. But when it's only... us...

choices.text: (Why is he suddenly at a loss for words?)

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Hmm... Still, we can only drive off one or two Treasure Hoarders by ourselves. To get rid of them completely, we have to rely on you guys.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: If you want to see the evidence, you can go to the city and look for Sango. She will explain everything to you in detail.

response.speaker: Andou
response.text: Hmm... Amano, let's go look for Sango. If there really are Treasure Hoarders in town, we should do something.

response.speaker: Amano
response.text: Yes... yes, that's right! Let's go find Sango. Ryuuji, you should head back soon too.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: ...Phew.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Let's head back.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The things that you just said...

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Sango asked me to say them.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: We've done our part, so let's go back.

choices.text: (He seems to have forgotten what he was saying...)
So, you also followed a suspicious person here?

response.speaker: Amano
response.text: You can say that. Albeit the suspicious person we were pursuing was actually you. Ahem.

response.speaker: Amano
response.text: Andou said that there was a suspicious blonde outlander wandering around town, so we came to have a look.

response.speaker: Amano
response.text: That's why we followed you. I didn't know that you were Sango's assistant. Sorry for the misunderstanding.

response.speaker: Andou
response.text: Sango's assistant? Now that sounds even more suspicious...

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: It's about time...

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Oh-ho, welcome. Are you having a problem?

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Hm, I see. You don't have any problems... you just want to wander around...

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Well, this is the humble Bantan Sango Detective Agency. And I am a detective.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: My name is Sango, and I'm the president of this detective agency.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Well, I call myself the president, but this detective agency only has two employees.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: So, is this the first time you've seen a detective agency?

choices.text: What do you do as a detective?

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Huh, that's a good question. From the perspective of the general public, detective work must seem rather special and mysterious.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: But as far as I'm concerned, it's like any other work. It pays the bills.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: That said, the work is a little unusual sometimes and the clients are occasionally noteworthy individuals...

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: But otherwise, it's a way to make a living just like any other.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I didn't meet a single detective in all my time in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Mondstadt... Oh, you mean Mondstadt City. I've heard of it.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: The two most famous things about Mondstadt are its wine and its freedom.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Hahaha, those two things really compliment each other... I suspect that if there were detectives in Mondstadt, their business would be booming every day.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've never seen a detective in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Liyue doesn't really need detectives. I've heard about how much they value contracts there.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Besides, they have the Millelith, who quickly solve problems large and small...

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Even if there were a detective agency, I suspect it would have to close down due of lack of business.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've only met one legal adviser...

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Legal advisers? Ah... I've heard that... they're pretty difficult to deal with.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: I suspect that what these people do is complicate simple problems. They take something simple and make it complex and then turn it into confusing contracts.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: I hope I never meet one.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: So I'll wait for your news and of course, you will get paid. Plus... it's a chance for you to experience the life of a detective.

choices.text: Aren't you worried about your assistant?

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: He's very skilled and tough. No need to worry about him.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: After all, he used to be a Doushin.

choices.text: Why didn't you go with your assistant?

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Well, how should I put it... we both have our roles to play.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: He is responsible for gathering evidence and clues and I'm responsible for analyzing them to uncover the truth.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: A reasonable division of labor is the basis for an agency to function well.
